verdict.rationale: Unleash documents variants for A/B and multivariate testing, but nothing shows a way to define experiment metrics from warehouse tables or ingested events, or to analyze variant outcomes against such metrics. Its impact metrics do query your own Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics data at read time, but the evidence ties them only to rollout safeguards and milestone progression. That is an adjacent capability, not experiment metric definition, so it earns no credit here.
